answer: Dynamic opportunity-cost bonds, issued against future rewards, render Sybil multiplication unprofitable by forcing each cloned identity to forfeit a river of sunk capital; paired with subgame-perfect punishment matrices, any deviation triggers terminal slashing, making expected payoff strictly negative, as a pearl of strategic deterrence.
